notes.note: R7 quantization delta only: compared scene candidate timestamps with raw keyframe times and the real 2.7s-GOP H.264 regression. FFmpeg rounds the 2.7s keyframe cut to 2.8s on the 5fps grid; the importer now matches keyframes on that same grid before applying preceding-GOP dedupe. The regression failed with the extra 2.8s cut before the fix and passed with exact [1000,13000,14000] afterward. Existing partial flushing, probe/scene/pipeline deadlines, preview/authority and transcription contracts are unchanged. These documents already describe preceding-GOP replacement or link its owning guide; no prose change needed. Source and local-media proof only; other claims and hosted/native/release behavior were not requalified.
